title: Regina Lead Service Connection — Canonical Burden Model
methodology_note: Bottom-up condition-based costing validated by top-down IQ-point convergence

top_down_gould.validated_by: Cathedral Village testing Sept 2025: 71% exceed 5 μg/L, several >100 μg/L, one at 570 μg/L (114× limit)

bottom_up_conditions.method: Condition-specific prevalence × annual treatment cost × duration
bottom_up_conditions.note: Healthcare system costs only — does not include family out-of-pocket or education system

convergence_check.convergence: Top-down ($48K/child total) and bottom-up healthcare ($36.9K/child health only) converge — healthcare is ~77% of total societal cost, consistent with Gould breakdown

population.method: 1 lead connection = 1 household address. Children per household = CT children ÷ CT dwellings.
population.source: StatsCan 2016 Census CT profiles × SewerWaterCondition Lead+PolyB spatial join

conditions.name: Learning disability / developmental delay
conditions.includes: Speech/occupational therapy ($3,000-8,000/yr), developmental assessment ($1,500-3,500 one-time), school support services

conditions.name: Chronic kidney disease
sources: Kidney Foundation of Canada cost data
conditions.note: Low expected value because low prevalence, but catastrophic individual cost

earnings_loss.method: IQ loss × earnings reduction per IQ point
earnings_loss.source: Salkever (1995) earnings model, StatsCan 2021 Census Regina median income
earnings_loss.validated_by: Gould (2009) $17,815/IQ point (2006 USD) inflation-adjusted = $35,131 CAD — our Canadian calc is more conservative

qaly.reference: Between GBD borderline intellectual disability (0.011) and mild anxiety (0.030). Population-level expected value.

cathedral_validation.source: Patricia Elliott, Get The Lead Out, Executive Committee Sept 17, 2023
cathedral_validation.note: Some Regina homes exceed filter capacity. 71% exceedance validates 2.0 IQ point base case.

sources: S4: City of Regina LSC Management Program
S8: CIHI Patient Cost Estimator + condition-specific CMGs
S10: Health Canada (2019) Drinking Water Guidelines
S15: Patricia Elliott / GTLO Cathedral testing (Sept 2025)
